reviews.comment:
La atención en playa 10 puntos, estaba lloviznando y sin embargo los chicos bien predispuestos.
En cuanto al full MALISIMO, mal predispueto el personal, y tardaron mas de 15' en prepararme un cafe con leche, pocos productos para CELIACOS de mala calidad.

(Translated by Google)
The service on the beach was excellent; it was drizzling, but the staff were very helpful.
However, the full-service restaurant was TERRIBLE. The staff was unhelpful, and it took them over 15 minutes to make me a coffee with milk. There were few gluten-free products available, and those that were available were of poor quality.
